<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916037_theRebbe_540" batchId="meluket-_D7_9B_D7_A1_D7_9C_D7_95_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916037_theRebbe_540__p008">
  <section v="21">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the commerce of Canaan is accomplished through Yaakov's settlement, which involves the soul's descent to refine the body and animal soul, elevating fallen sparks of holiness from the vessels of Tohu, and that this refinement must be done in a way of closeness and feeling, ultimately bringing peace even with the serpent.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">3)</t>
    <t s="2">And behold, the matter of the commerce,</t>
    <t s="3">of Canaan mentioned above,</t>
    <t s="4">is through "And Yaakov settled,"</t>
    <t s="5">the descent</t>
    <t s="6">and lowering of the soul below to refine the body and the Nefesh HaBahamis and its portion in the world,</t>
    <t s="7">the refinement, purification, and elevation of the sparks of holiness that fell in the broken vessels of Tohu,</t>
    <t s="8">and this is that the settlements of Yaakov came about through the settlements of Esav and his descendants before the King, the King of Israel, and the settlements of Esav are specifically in a short path,</t>
    <t s="9">in the manner of the saying of our sages of blessed memory</t>
    <t s="10">(in holiness)</t>
    <t s="11">"A person teaches his student a short path,"</t>
    <t s="12">the few vessels of Tohu,</t>
    <t s="13">and they were not stored away</t>
    <t s="14">(and hidden),</t>
    <t s="15">for in their root, Yaakov preceded,</t>
    <t s="16">and they were not significant,</t>
    <t s="17">for "judgment did not please Him,"</t>
    <t s="18">and the desired refinement is in a manner of closeness,</t>
    <t s="19">specifically closeness and feeling</t>
    <t s="20">(and as will be explained at length below),</t>
    <t s="21">for then "with many,</t>
    <t s="22">the souls of Esav" (the term "many" is plural),</t>
    <t s="23">"were with me,"</t>
    <t s="24">so that no spark of holiness will be rejected as above,</t>
    <t s="25">and until even his enemies make peace with him—this is the serpent,</t>
    <t s="26">the serpent that causes death in the world,</t>
    <t s="27">in the aspect of "Rav,"</t>
    <t s="28">there will be peace,</t>
    <t s="29">"and abundant peace to your children,"</t>
    <t s="30">"He redeemed in peace."</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the commerce of Canaan is accomplished through Yaakov's settlement, which involves the soul's descent to refine the body and animal soul, elevating fallen sparks of holiness from the vessels of Tohu, and that this refinement must be done in a way of closeness and feeling, ultimately bringing peace even with the serpent.

translations.translation: And behold, the matter of the commerce,
and lowering of the soul below to refine the body and the Nefesh HaBahamis and its portion in the world,
the refinement, purification, and elevation of the sparks of holiness that fell in the broken vessels of Tohu,

and this is that the settlements of Yaakov came about through the settlements of Esav and his descendants before the King, the King of Israel, and the settlements of Esav are specifically in a short path,
in the manner of the saying of our sages of blessed memory
"A person teaches his student a short path,"
and they were not stored away
for in their root, Yaakov preceded,
and the desired refinement is in a manner of closeness,
(and as will be explained at length below),
the souls of Esav" (the term "many" is plural),
so that no spark of holiness will be rejected as above,
and until even his enemies make peace with him—this is the serpent,
the serpent that causes death in the world,
